name: POSH Committee Member
description: Child table row for a member of a POSH Internal Committee. Drives all IC compliance checks (gender, external member, presiding officer). External org/NGO required when role is External Member or NGO/Expert.

fields.label: Role in IC
fields.options:
Presiding Officer
Internal Member
External Member
NGO/Expert
fields.description: Presiding Officer: senior woman employee. Internal Member: employee committed to women's issues. External Member/NGO: outsider — mandatory 1 required.
